findings.message: 14 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 11 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Barbearia Sr. Navalha" above "Seu corte começa aqui."; "Agendar no AppBarber" above "O corte tem técnica. O cuidado tem nome."; "O valor varia conforme o tamanho do cabelo." above "Damião"; "O valor varia conforme o tamanho do cabelo." above "Eduardo"; "Para todos os tipos de pele" above "Kauã"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 4 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Cortesmodernos", "Barbacom precisão", "Atendimentode confiança", "Em Gravatá, PE").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.
Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 72 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header#topo.header.nv2-header 1672px | details.service-row 864px | details.service-row 864px | details.service-row 864px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 2 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (4, 4 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 1 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.
Fix the URL or replace the asset.

findings.message: Little motion: 11 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Give every section an entrance for its parts (not one fade of the whole block) and add one moving picture: a looping clip or a slow move on a photograph.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: No headline found in the first viewport.
findings.fix: The first screen needs a clear focal statement or image.
